deviations.what: c6 S5 / c6 c13 *The card, four ages*: the frame tints amounts by age — amber for an advance in hand, red past 30 days ('₹3,600', '₹6,400', '₹5,800') — and the 48-day row's second line in red
deviations.reason: [canvas-wrong] status colours (warning/danger) never colour amounts; the age is carried by the status word and icon. Separately, a [screen] violation of 07 §1 rule 3 🔒 in the app itself: advance_aged_row.dart:77-81 draws the remaining amount with MoneyText(vocabulary: professional, favour: unfavourable) and no showDirection, and the professional branch of money_format.dart formats paise.abs() unsigned and tints it status.debit — so captures S5__holding and S5__given-out show a bare red '₹3,000', '₹8,000', '₹3,500' with no sign and no word. A tinted amount must carry its sign or a word (or be drawn in ink); the fix is the advances owner's
